name: tree-sitter-lhat
description: Tree-sitter grammars for L^ and LTON

scripts.generate: tree-sitter generate --abi 14 && cd lton && tree-sitter generate --abi 14
scripts.test: tree-sitter test && cd lton && tree-sitter test
